subject: Independent seam and finite-element resolution diagnostics for the rational C(u)+r(u)Q(v) root addition
required_before_any_mesh_or_field_analys: New STEP must first pass the unchanged CAD, interface, mass and STEP gates; no analysis of a rejected STEP.

geometry_seams.requirement: Two G1 rails alone do not admit exposed C0 longitudinal caps; original protected geometry and all existing gates remain unchanged.

local_radius: Use the actual declared r(u) on each fixed-X section; nominal1mm is an upper bound, not a claim of constant normal-section radius.

one_local_refinement_rule.trigger: Identical local resolution in mesh9/7, insufficient chord resolution, or peak stability not established by those actual local meshes.
one_local_refinement_rule.size_change: Halve the measured local characteristic length of the fine mesh once, restricted to the declared blend and transition band; retain the global fine-mesh prescription elsewhere.
one_local_refinement_rule.interpretation: Report measured changes. Do not infer a rigorous peak error bound, Richardson order or convergence solely from two global labels or one local halving.
